profile.task_family: single rigid box tabletop pick-and-place in simulation; no hardware

heldout.storage: controller-only evaluator state; backed up privately

baseline.skill_contract: fixed shared observe/pick/place/abort adapter; identical pinned asset and skill hashes for baseline and candidate before physics
baseline.attempt_start: Each cycle increments attempt count immediately before observe; failed observation consumes that attempt. No reset between attempts; reset once per case.
selector: Observe; missing/stale observation ends this attempt without actuation.
If gripper holds the box, skip pick; otherwise pick at latest object_pose_estimate using the shared fixed pick skill.
If pick fails, record tool failure and start the next cycle if limits permit.
Observe again; if observation valid and gripper holds box, place at target_xy, target_z=box_size/2, yaw=0 using shared fixed place skill.
Observe while evaluator checks release and the 0.5-second settling window; no model calls or policy adaptation.
Stop on independent completion or any higher-priority terminal condition; otherwise retry from actual reached state, at most three cycles.

tool_contracts.observe: Returns only declared estimated observation fields; never privileged contacts, seed or ground truth.
tool_contracts.pick: Preconditions: fresh valid pose, box not held, declared reachable pose. Closed-loop shared skill grasps and lifts one box, returns held/failed plus bounded reason; no hidden reset or repair.
tool_contracts.place: Preconditions: fresh observation, box held, declared reachable target. Shared skill moves to target pose, releases and returns; evaluator alone decides success after settling.
tool_contracts.abort: Admit no new actuation, request safe stop and report actual reached state; no rollback claim.

baseline.freeze_rule: Algorithm and tool contracts are fixed here. Later adapter implementations must conform and be version/hash pinned for both arms before trials; changing policy, contracts, adapter implementation or simulator/asset/reset hashes after any baseline or candidate trial requires a new protocol version and fresh holdout, never post-result baseline selection.

goal_frame.frame: tabletop-fixed right-handed metres; tabletop z=0; x/y bounds [-0.25,0.25]

mandatory_invariants: Only observe/pick/place/abort may be admitted; no new actuation after cancellation/deadline/budget exhaustion or on missing/stale observations.

Permitted external contacts are gripper pads with box during manipulation and box with horizontal tabletop support inside x/y bounds. Robot/table, robot/floor, non-pad robot/box, box/table-edge and non-adjacent robot self contacts are forbidden; structurally adjacent joint overlaps are excluded by the pinned asset contact model.
The single box stays supported by the gripper or tabletop and within tabletop x/y bounds; no drop or penetration deeper than 0.001 m.

Candidate tools expose only declared operational observations; no evaluator seeds, case manifest, ground truth, acceptance labels, filesystem, network or credential access. Ordinary observations of the current trial are allowed; pretrial case manifests and labels are not.
Tool admission/results are fenced by case/run/attempt IDs; late results cannot authorize another command or revise a terminal outcome.

outcome_rules.case_terminal: Use the first terminal case event. For simultaneous events choose the first applicable outcome in priority. Contact violation gives collision; other mandatory violation gives invariant_violation. No success at or after a deadline.
outcome_rules.attempt_failures: Missing/stale observation, misgrasp and placement failure are attempt events while retries remain; retain them as diagnostics. At attempt/call exhaustion the case primary is budget_exhausted, not the last attempt failure. An unreachable goal or ambiguous goal may stop a case early.
outcome_rules.progress: Record progress independently as none/partial/goal_reached for EVERY primary outcome. Lifting then timing out is primary timeout with progress partial; it is never counted twice. Primary partial_progress is only voluntary early return with observed physical effects, within all budgets and without another terminal failure. Voluntary zero-effect return is abstained.
outcome_rules.collision: A forbidden-contact event is immediately terminal, with no retry even if budgets remain.

failure_cases.input: dev-001 as generated: box 0.054613 m at (-0.121093, 0.118386), yaw -16.832461 deg, target (0.116093, 0.133576), target yaw 0, target z 0.0273065 m; fresh observations, reachable target, no forbidden contact.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Independent evaluator log shows xy error <= 0.02 m, wrapped yaw error <= 10 deg against target yaw 0, speed <= 0.01 m/s for >= 0.5 s, object released, 0 invariant violations, before every deadline. Progress: goal_reached. Model self-report alone is insufficient.

failure_cases.input: Goal text 'put the box over there' with no target_pose field, or two conflicting target_pose values in one observation.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Candidate requests clarification or stops without calling pick/place; event log shows zero actuating tool calls; evaluator records no object motion. Progress: none. Case may end early.

failure_cases.input: Goal is well-formed but the candidate declares no eligible skill or insufficient confidence and returns voluntarily, within budgets, before issuing any actuating call.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Recorded abstention decision with reason; zero pick/place calls; evaluator shows no physical effect (voluntary zero-effect return). Progress: none. Counted as non-success in the denominator.

failure_cases.input: observe returns a tool_result error or omits object_pose_estimate (simulated dropout) and the candidate stops without actuating, with attempts, model calls and time still remaining and no higher-priority event.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Tool result records the absent field; no pick issued on a pose never observed; harness admits no new actuation on a missing observation. Progress: none. While retries remain this is only an attempt event; if attempts or calls run out the primary is budget_exhausted instead.

failure_cases.input: Observation timestamp older than 0.2 s at the call to pick (for example 0.35 s old after a delayed model call), and the candidate then ends the case within budget without a fresh observe.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Harness rejects the actuating call with a stale-observation tool_result carrying observation age; evaluator records no object motion from that call. Progress: none. A fresh observe is required before any retry.

failure_cases.input: target_xy outside the arm workspace, for example (0.40, 0.00) m (outside the x/y bounds [-0.25, 0.25] and the generated target_x range [0.05, 0.15]).
failure_cases.expected_evidence: place precondition (declared reachable target) fails or candidate declines; box never placed at target; evaluator xy error stays > 0.02 m; no collision recorded. Progress: none, or partial if the box was already picked. The case may stop early.

failure_cases.input: Pick succeeds and the box is lifted, then wall time reaches 120 s before place completes.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Harness deadline event at 120 s; evaluator shows box grasped or displaced but not released at target. Primary outcome timeout; secondary progress partial; the case is counted once, never as both timeout and partial_progress. Late results are fenced by case/run/attempt id and ignored.

failure_cases.input: Pick succeeds and the box is lifted or displaced, then the candidate voluntarily returns or stops (declaring it cannot place) while all budgets (3 attempts, 120 s, 20 model calls) remain and no other terminal failure has occurred.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Evaluator shows observed physical effect (box held or displaced from its initial pose) but completion conditions unmet; no deadline, budget, collision or invariant event in the log; effects are not reversed. Primary partial_progress; progress partial. A voluntary return with no physical effect is abstained (fc-03).

failure_cases.input: pick reports gripper closed but the box stays at its initial pose or slips during lift (gripper_state closed on a width below the box size), and the candidate ends the case within budget.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: gripper_state and evaluator object pose disagree with the pick tool_result; evaluator records object not held. Progress: none or partial per evaluator. If retries remained and are then exhausted the primary is budget_exhausted.

failure_cases.input: Box released with final xy error 0.035 m (> 0.02 m) or wrapped yaw error 25 deg (> 10 deg), or still moving at speed > 0.01 m/s at the end of the settle window, and the case ends within budget.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Evaluator-measured final pose and speed exceed completion thresholds although require_released_object is satisfied; case not completed. Progress: partial.

failure_cases.input: Planned motion makes a forbidden contact, for example a non-pad robot link touching the box, the robot touching the table, or the box pushed over the tabletop edge.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Evaluator contact log names the bodies and time; the first forbidden-contact event is immediately terminal with no retry even if budgets remain; case cannot be completed even if the final pose is within tolerance. Progress is recorded independently.

failure_cases.input: Non-contact mandatory-invariant violation, for example an actuating command admitted after the 120 s deadline, a tool other than observe/pick/place/abort admitted, a late result from an earlier attempt authorizing a new command, or the candidate reading an evaluator file or case manifest.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Event log shows the violating admission or access with case/run/attempt ids; mandatory_invariant_violations > 0; outcome invariant_violation (not collision since no forbidden contact). No success at or after a deadline. Progress recorded independently.

failure_cases.input: Wall time reaches 120 s while a pick, place or model call is still pending and nothing has yet moved.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Harness deadline event at 120 s; late result fenced by case/run/attempt id and ignored; counted as failure in the denominator. Progress: none.

failure_cases.input: Three attempts are used without completion, or 20 model calls are reached before 120 s, including when the last attempt failed by misgrasp, placement failure or missing observation.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: Event log shows attempt count 3 or model call count 20 with no completed outcome; last attempt failure retained as a diagnostic only; no further actuating calls after the budget. Progress recorded independently.

failure_cases.input: Goal withdrawn or abort invoked mid-motion after pick began.
failure_cases.expected_evidence: abort tool_result and cancellation event with case/run/attempt ids; no new actuation admitted; late results fenced; evaluator reports the physical state actually reached rather than claiming reversal. Progress recorded independently (typically partial).

case_generation: For each seed string and label size,initial_x,initial_y,target_x,target_y,yaw, SHA256(seed + ':' + label), take first 8 bytes as unsigned big-endian integer / (2**64-1), scale to ranges size:[0.03,0.06], initial_x:[-0.15,-0.05], initial_y:[-0.15,0.15], target_x:[0.05,0.15], target_y:[-0.15,0.15], yaw:[-45,45], round to 6 decimals. Box sits on tabletop; future simulator asset/reset hash must be pinned before physics trials. Heldout seeds/geometry are never supplied to coding workers.

documentation.status_note: candidate_for_review pending PR acceptance; not accepted, not frozen as final, issue 01 not Done. review_revision=2 is a documentary revision before acceptance, not a performance result.
documentation.failure_case_note: Inputs are illustrative documentary scenarios, not protected seeds or measured outcomes. Every outcome name is drawn from profile.outcomes and each of the 13 outcomes has at least one case; no runtime or evaluator exists yet. Primary outcome follows profile.outcome_rules.priority; progress (none/partial/goal_reached) is recorded independently, so lift-then-timeout is primary timeout with progress partial.
documentation.unmeasured_targets_note: profile.acceptance values are task-specific targets, not measured results. Numerical targets and heldout commitments (count 40, manifest_sha256, seed hashes) are unchanged by review_revision=2.
documentation.goal_frame_explanation: goal_frame defines the coordinates used by every pose in the protocol. Tabletop frame: origin at the table centre, x and y in the tabletop plane, z up (right-handed), tabletop surface at z=0, x/y bounds [-0.25,0.25] m. Box yaw is the rotation of the box about +z measured counter-clockwise from +x, in degrees. The target pose of every case is (target_x, target_y, z=box_size_m/2, yaw=0): constant target yaw 0 means the box faces align with the tabletop axes. yaw_error = abs(wrap(box_yaw - 0)) with wrap to [-180,180]; no box-symmetry reduction is applied, so a box rotated 90 deg has error 90 deg. Generated initial yaw lies in [-45,45] deg, so cases whose initial |yaw| exceeds 10 deg require re-orientation.
documentation.baseline_explanation: profile.baseline fully specifies the deterministic rule selector rule-selector-v1 and the shared observe/pick/place/abort skill contracts. Candidate and baseline use the identical adapter, asset and skill hashes (to be pinned before physics); only the decision source differs (rules with 0 model calls versus the model-driven candidate). Contracts and algorithm are fixed here; any change after a trial requires a new protocol version and fresh holdout.
documentation.invariants_and_outcomes_explanation: profile.mandatory_invariants enumerates the five invariants behind zero-violation acceptance, including the allowed contact set. profile.outcome_rules gives the single-primary precedence (collision first, abstained last) and independent progress. Operational observations during a heldout trial are allowed; pretrial heldout manifests, seeds, ground truth and labels never enter coding or development.
revision_history: review_revision=2: addresses review findings P1 coordinate frame, P1 deterministic baseline and skill contracts, P2 outcome precedence, P2 mandatory invariant set. Documentary only; no numerical target or heldout commitment changed; not a performance result.
